name: LoopHQ — AI Chat & Lead Capture
author: loophq

sections.description:
Don’t lose leads because you can’t respond fast enough.

LoopHQ adds an intelligent AI chatbot to your WordPress site that answers customer questions instantly — trained on YOUR content, not generic responses. It works 24/7, captures leads automatically, and sends them straight to your inbox or CRM.

Why LoopHQ?

  • Trained on your content — Upload documents, add Q&A, or import your website. Your chatbot knows YOUR business.
  • Captures leads automatically — Smart forms appear at the right moment to capture name, email, and phone.
  • Google Calendar booking — Visitors book appointments directly in the chat. Real-time availability, automatic calendar invites.
  • Works while you sleep — 24/7 availability means you never miss a potential customer.
  • Multi-language — Supports English and Spanish with automatic detection.
  • Mobile-optimized — Beautiful on every device.
  • No coding required — Install, paste your Project ID, done.

Who is LoopHQ for?

Any business with a website: home services, health & wellness, professional services (law, accounting, real estate), auto services, beauty & personal care, SaaS, e-commerce, and more.

Pricing

The WordPress plugin is free. LoopHQ offers a free plan with 50 messages/month. Paid plans start at $39/month for more messages, advanced features, and multiple agents. View plans

How it works

  1. Sign up for a free LoopHQ account at loophq.dev
  2. Create your AI agent and train it on your content
  3. Install this plugin and paste your Project ID
  4. Your chatbot appears on every page — ready to engage visitors

All customization (colors, position, welcome message, lead capture settings) is managed from your LoopHQ dashboard. Changes apply instantly — no plugin updates needed.

External Service

This plugin relies on LoopHQ as a third-party service to provide AI chatbot functionality. A free LoopHQ account is required.

What the plugin sends to LoopHQ:

  • Your Project ID — to load the correct chatbot configuration
  • A deployment ping on plugin activation — to confirm your chatbot is live (contains only your Project ID and the source “wordpress”)

What loads on your site:

  • The LoopHQ widget script (https://loophq.dev/widget.js) is loaded asynchronously on every page for visitors to interact with your chatbot. Visitor chat messages are processed by LoopHQ’s AI service.

Service links:

  • LoopHQ Terms of Service
  • LoopHQ Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for LoopHQ
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to Settings → LoopHQ
  5. Paste your Project ID (from your LoopHQ dashboard → Deploy tab)
  6. Click Save Changes — your chatbot is live!

Don’t have a LoopHQ account? Sign up free — no credit card required.
sections.faq:
Do I need a LoopHQ account?

Yes. The plugin connects your WordPress site to your LoopHQ AI agent. Sign up free — takes 2 minutes.

Is it free?

The plugin is completely free. LoopHQ has a free plan with 50 messages/month. Paid plans unlock more messages, advanced analytics, lead scoring, and more.

How do I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

All visual settings (color, position, welcome message, popup timing) are managed from your LoopHQ dashboard. Changes apply instantly on your WordPress site — no plugin update needed.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The chatbot works with all WordPress themes including Elementor, Divi, GeneratePress, Astra, and the default Twenty Twenty-Five theme.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The widget script loads asynchronously and works with WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, and others.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The script loads asynchronously (non-blocking) and has zero impact on your page load speed. It’s under 26KB.

What happens if I run out of credits?

The chatbot gracefully shows a contact fallback (email/phone) so visitors can still reach you. It automatically reactivates when credits are available.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

Each LoopHQ agent has its own Project ID. You can install the plugin on multiple WordPress sites — each pointing to the same or different agents depending on your plan.
